findings.summary: After restoring a paper and replacing that same paper, recover_library returns LIGHT_LIBRARY_NEEDS_RECOVERY because the completed restore has no live paper and no unique archive successor.
findings.scope: T2 light_library owner implementation; T3 records and avoids this vector in its integrated pipeline test.

findings.summary: Both recorded full-tree runs have 33 tests/closure errors from uv build --offline failing to resolve hatchling in the worktree cache. The product/research/unit suites and owned installed-wheel check pass.
findings.scope: Validation environment; use the populated UV_CACHE_DIR together with LW2_UV_CACHE for the final dual full-suite replay.
